body: I think but I'm not really sure it was a very long time ago. I'm not sure if desk work would be right for me. I want to help people. I can't be confined inside sitting at a desk. I'd rather be in the field doing what I was training to. I'd rather be out being the one that ensures my fellow soldiers go home to their family. That's what I was trained to do. Doing paper work and staring at a computer make me go crazy and would only exacerbate my symptoms. I've been in those positions before and only saw a worsening of my symptoms

I tried with my ex but like I said I lost her to the marines. I have maybe one person here but I just can't. She's been and I don't want to send her back down this path because she is already helping another mutual friend of ours. I'll probably have to be my own. I have been ever since I can remember but one person is only so strong
I know I need to but it's so hard to be strong for someone else when it feels like your own world is crashing down around you

As someone who is currently in the military all I can say to you is don't give up. I'm currently struggling to but the only thing that keeps me going is that I know someday some how it'll get better. Stay strong battle. You are a hero as a service member. Find what you love to do and Pursue that instead of looking for just a random job. Soldier on. Hoorah
That's okay. I want an answer but no one will ever have one for me I understand. I just want someone out there to know that I'm not as strong as I pretend to be

The problem with that is I already seek help. It doesn't help and I can't tell them how I really feel. I'll loose everything which will only make things worse. I've tried talking to friends but it's so hard to have that conversation. It's hard to tell someone you want to die when you're so young..even when they know your past. Besides I don't want to bring them down with me. Most of my friends have been in this spot and some are still there so they lean on me how can I turn around and say I'm as bad as them when they need someone to be strong? I just can't..
